_doc: Curated RUNTIME i18n leaks the literal scanner cannot see: the format string is translated (green), but a %s argument is composed at runtime by a helper (s_suffix/makeplural/xname/urole.name.m/align_gtitle/corpse_xname) and stays English. Merged inline into coverage-core.mjs reshapeCFile(). status 'runtime-leak' (open, magenta, counts as a gap) vs 'runtime-fixed' (fixed:true, green, not a gap). Set fixed:true once the underlying code is fixed AND the wasm rebuilt; delete the entry after the user confirms in playtest. CAUTION: coverage-core JSON.parse()s this file — keep each src/<file> key UNIQUE (duplicate keys silently collapse to last-wins and drop earlier entries; merged 2026-07-08). NOTE: this file is for English LEAKS only; present-but-WRONG zh (word order/mistranslation) is tracked in the SIBLING file scripts/i18n/translation-defects.json (status zh-defect, also merged by coverage-core + rendered in the dashboard). See memory composed-message-word-order.
